basis: Blepharophimosis, intellectual disability and patellar abnormalities define this overlap syndrome; other organ involvement is insufficiently documented.
Respiratory ciliary dysfunction causes bronchiectasis in 9/9; otitis media occurs in only 2/9, below threshold.
Lysosomal glycoprotein storage disorders commonly cause neurodevelopmental impairment or degeneration and skeletal dysostosis, each in roughly ≥30% across the group.
Developmental delay and intellectual disability characterize affected patients; short stature alone does not establish skeletal or endocrine disease.
HPO: ataxia and hearing loss 80-99%, renal insufficiency 30-79%; neurologic findings concentrate in severe forms. Aortic abnormalities omitted by cap.
Inherited peripheral neuropathy; chronic denervation causes distal muscle atrophy and structural foot deformities in most patients.
Asymmetric skeletal growth and short stature identify the apparent affected axis; no definition or phenotype data establish additional organs.
Carcinoma originates in the transitional zone of the anal canal.
Hereditary optic nerve degeneration with optic atrophy in 4/4; the optic nerve belongs to the ocular axis.
Inherited hearing loss defines this umbrella; additional organ disease is not shared across its subtypes.
Congenital retinal degeneration defines LCA10; seizures reported in 2/4 support neurologic involvement, with uncertainty from the small sample.
Mature B-cell lymphoma; extranodal sites vary across subtypes, without a consistently affected additional organ across the umbrella.
Urothelial carcinoma originates in the ureter, included in the renal axis.
An infantile epilepsy syndrome defined by recurrent seizures.
Langerhans-cell neoplasm usually producing a destructive bone lesion; skin and lung are alternative sites without established ≥30% involvement.
Functional neutrophil defect impairing antimicrobial activity; infection-related organ damage is not common enough to add another axis.
Smooth-muscle malignancy arising in the ovary, a reproductive site; no defining endocrine involvement.
Tumour occupies the optic nerve sheath; this local optic apparatus disease belongs to the ocular axis.
Idiopathic pain localized to the vulva, outside the axes; the definition does not establish peripheral nerve disease or another covered organ disorder.
Mesomelic skeletal dysplasia defines abnormal development of the middle limb segments; no additional organ involvement is supplied.
Verrucous squamous carcinoma originates in plantar skin.
Neonatal clonal myeloid proliferation; clinically significant hepatic injury is a minority complication, and later leukemia is a separate disease.
Glycosylation defect with defining developmental impairment; VSD and gingival/dental overgrowth each reported in 2/3. Bleeding is occasional (5-29%).
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss in 8/8; other DCDC2-associated diseases are separate concepts.
Defining hepatic and cardiac disease; palatal defects in 4/4 and hearing loss in 2/2. Renal and spinal abnormalities in small samples omitted by cap.
